Subject: Request: pilot top-up & extension for SeedForge cohort

Hey Markus,

Thanks again for the support so far — SeedForge team has been working through the pilot but we ran into a gating issue in the last week (SOC2 evidence review slowed our infra onboarding). We’re three weeks into the pilot and expect to be ready to ramp usage after the SOC2 checklist clears, but right now we’ll run out of the free trial allocation in ~72 hours.

Request: would Redwood consider a one-time top-up of credits (we estimate ~40k tokens / ~$2k equivalent) and a 14-day extension on the trial window? That will let us complete the integration and finish the evaluation milestones your team asked for.

Why this matters: our demo for a cohort investor day is Feb 25 and we need to show stable latency and cost numbers; without the extra credits we’ll have an incomplete evaluation which risks delaying a purchase decision.

Attached a short milestones doc showing where we are (seedforge-milestones.pdf). Happy to jump on a quick call if it helps.

Appreciate any flexibility — Alex
Alex Tan
Head of Platform & Integrations
SeedForge

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and for the milestone doc, looks clear. I can’t approve credits from my mailbox alone, so I’m looping in Laura and Monica to evaluate an exception.

Prelim idea: we typically do a conditional one-time top-up tied to a short extension (7–14 days) and a small set of success criteria (demo completed, one post-demo usage spike, and a brief follow-up call). If that’s acceptable, Laura/Monica — can you confirm what level we can commit to for SeedForge? If needed we can request a light MSA addendum to capture the trial extension.

Alex — can you share a screenshot of current usage/estimates and confirm the single sign-on domain you’ll use? That’ll speed approvals.

–Markus

Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Markus / Monica — reviewed Alex’s milestone doc and usage ask. Recommendation from GTM ops and Billing: approve one-time top-up of 40k token-equivalent credit + 14-day trial extension on the condition that:

- SeedForge signs a one-page MSA addendum (captures extension and scope)
- They confirm SSO domain and provide proof of intent to run demo (calendar invite or a public event listing)
- We receive a follow-up usage snapshot 24–48 hours post-demo

If they meet those, we’ll consider converting to a paid commitment at the end of the trial (open to discussing committed monthly volumes). I’ve attached the intake/approval stub for legal to sign (topup-approval-form.pdf).

Please note: accounting prefers credits be capped and one-off; no recurring obligations. If Alex requests more than 40k we’ll escalate to sales leadership.

Laura Bennett
Head of Growth Ops
Redwood Inference

2) Please reply with the SSO domain you’ll use (example: corp.seedforge.io) and attach the demo calendar invite or a link to the public event.
3) After demo, send a quick usage snapshot (screenshot or csv export) to me and Monica so we can clear the final credit release.
